headline: AI sell-off erases Nasdaq's 2026 gains; $7.25B Roundup deal approved; COP31 stalls on fossil fuels

austin.headline: Chito Vela runs for Texas Senate, will leave council
austin.summary: The council member is seeking the District 14 seat Sarah Eckhardt is vacating after winning the comptroller race, and will serve until a special election for his council seat is called.

austin.headline: Feds concede deported Austin man is a US citizen
austin.summary: In a motion to dismiss his lawsuit, federal prosecutors acknowledged Brian José Morales García holds dual US-Mexico citizenship after he was deported following a DPS traffic stop, while arguing the agencies are immune.

austin.headline: Empty Bowl marks 30 years with 3,000 handmade bowls
austin.summary: The Sunday-before-Thanksgiving fundraiser at the Central Texas Food Bank sells $30 locally made bowls of donated soup, with proceeds to the food bank and Meals on Wheels Central Texas.

texas.headline: Texas Supreme Court ends Heartbeat Act challenge
texas.summary: The court dismissed the long-running consolidated case against the 2021 six-week abortion ban without ruling on the merits, leaving its private-lawsuit enforcement in place.

texas.headline: Court declines to hear 'Death Star' law challenge
texas.summary: The lower-court ruling upholding the 2023 law limiting local ordinances stands, and Democrats including Gov.-elect Hinojosa plan to seek repeal in January.

texas.headline: Paxton drops abortion pill suits against out-of-state providers
texas.summary: The attorney general withdrew cases against two California doctors and a Delaware nurse practitioner, part of a wave of dismissals before he leaves office in January.

texas.headline: State also drops suit against Latino voter group Jolt
texas.summary: Paxton's office dismissed its bid to revoke the nonprofit's charter, months after a federal judge found no plausible proof it broke the law.

texas.headline: Patrick objects to ERCOT CEO's contract extension
texas.summary: Pablo Vegas's six-year extension, worth up to $29.5 million, was finalized this week, and the outgoing lieutenant governor said he was not consulted and opposed it.

texas.headline: Ombudsman says youth prison lockdown backfired
texas.summary: An independent review found the August lockdown of all five state youth prisons, confining more than 700 children up to 23 hours a day, increased self-harm without reducing assaults on staff at most sites.

us.headline: Judge approves Bayer's $7.25 billion Roundup settlement
us.summary: A St. Louis judge approved a deal paying claimants over up to 21 years to resolve lymphoma claims linked to the weed killer, which Bayer denies causes cancer; an appeal is possible.

us.headline: Record rain floods Florida's Atlantic coast
us.summary: More than 17 inches fell in places since Tuesday, forcing dozens of rescues and pushing the St. Johns River past its 1953 record near Cocoa, with flooding expected into next week.

us.headline: Man convicted of starting deadly 2025 Palisades Fire
us.summary: A federal jury in Los Angeles found the defendant guilty of igniting the fire.

us.headline: Trump touts Xi and Putin talks at White House briefing
us.summary: In a lengthy news conference after his Asia trip, the president praised the summit but pointed to few concrete outcomes.

us.headline: Tillis blocks Trump's CISA nominee
us.summary: The senator put a hold on the cybersecurity agency nominee, who had declined to acknowledge the Jan. 6 attack.

australia.headline: Australia and China agree to hold AI talks
australia.summary: Albanese and Premier Li Qiang struck the deal in Beijing as the prime minister wrapped up his trip, while Australia also signed a US-led declaration on protecting the AI supply chain.

australia.headline: Teen charged after Castle Hill food court stabbing
australia.summary: Police allege a 17-year-old stabbed two 16-year-old boys at Castle Towers on Friday; one is in a critical condition.

australia.headline: One Nation receives $25,000 from Tasmanian salmon firm
australia.summary: A salmon farming company and a lobbyist made large donations to the party in Tasmania.

australia.headline: Petition against AI cameras at junior basketball tops 13,000
australia.summary: Parents are raising concerns about Basketball Australia's use of AI cameras to film junior games.

australia.headline: Sixty years since the marriage bar on public servants lifted
australia.summary: Women recall working around the ban that forced married women out of the Commonwealth public service.

ai.headline: AI sell-off pushes Nasdaq negative for 2026
ai.summary: The S&P 500 fell and the Nasdaq composite erased its gains for the year as worries about AI spending weighed on markets.

ai.headline: Nvidia's losing streak is its longest since 2008
ai.summary: The chipmaker's shares closed out a seventh straight losing week, with a 14% slide.

ai.headline: SoftBank has its worst day in over two years
ai.summary: The AI sell-off hit Asian tech stocks the day after Anthropic's market debut.

ai.headline: Cursor weighs phasing out Chinese AI models
ai.summary: The SpaceX-owned coding tool told lawmakers it is considering dropping Chinese models over geopolitical risk.

ai.headline: Anthropic employee claims AI-aided solution to famed math problem
ai.summary: A worker says he used AI to help solve a 167-year-old problem; the claim has not yet been independently verified.

tech.headline: Commerce Department scrutinized over chip smuggling probe
tech.summary: Questions are mounting over the department's handling of its Megaspeed investigation into alleged Nvidia chip smuggling.

tech.headline: Tech disruptions raise US cybersecurity concerns
tech.summary: A string of recent outages and disruptions has renewed questions about the resilience of American digital infrastructure.

world.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no fossil fuel language
world.summary: The latest draft deal at the climate talks in Antalya omits any mention of fossil fuels, drawing criticism as nearly 200 nations remained deadlocked.

world.headline: EU and Indonesia sign free trade deal after a decade
world.summary: The agreements would remove 98.5% of tariffs on EU goods once ratified by the European Parliament and Indonesia, possibly from early next year.

world.headline: Rights groups seek sanctions after Myanmar genocide ruling
world.summary: Advocates are urging governments to act against Myanmar following the International Court of Justice finding on the Rohingya.

world.headline: Restoration uncovers tunnels beneath Hagia Sophia
world.summary: Turkish officials said nine tunnels and six underground spaces have been found, with 420 metres cleaned so far and possible visitor access under consideration.

aus-cricket.headline: CA board unanimously backs Cummins as captain
aus-cricket.summary: Cricket Australia's board stood by Pat Cummins amid the renewed sandpaper fallout, and Usman Khawaja and David Warner were stood down from Fox Cricket's T20 commentary.

aus-cricket.headline: Hazlewood defends Cummins over 2018 scandal
aus-cricket.summary: The fast bowler said he knew nothing of the ball tampering and backed Cummins to stay on, after Cameron Bancroft alleged the whole team knew.

aus-cricket.headline: T20I series against England opens at the MCG
aus-cricket.summary: Mitch Marsh leads Australia in the five-match series starting Saturday night, with Sam Harper set to debut as wicketkeeper.

warriors.headline: Dec. 1 Jazz game moved an hour earlier
warriors.summary: The league shifted Golden State's home game against Utah to 7 p.m. Pacific; the Warriors next host Boston on Sunday with Stephen Curry still out.
